body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Sony Ericsson introduced its Walkman phone 'W508' at 2009 CES, which enables users to have interactive mobile experience with clever technology such as Shake and Gesture control and SenseMe.
Shake control and Gesture control allows you to become your own DJ with just a flick of your wrist – raise the volume or set the shuffle function by giving your phone a quick shake.

The W508 also includes popular Walkman features such as SensMe, for matching your mood to the music and touch keys on top to play, stop and skip tracks. Other features included a 3.2M camera, HSDPA and 1GB M2 card.
